# Breadcrumbs

The path from the home page to where the reader is.

```tsx
import { Breadcrumbs } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- On pages two or more levels deep.

## When not to

- As the only navigation, or on top-level pages.

## Examples

### Site path

The last item is the current page: it is text, not a link.

```tsx
<Breadcrumbs items={[{ label: 'Inicio', href: '#inicio' }, { label: 'Educación', href: '#educacion' }, { label: 'La arquitectura del texto' }]} />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` (required) | `BreadcrumbItem[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the navigation. Defaults to the localised "Ruta de navegación". |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Pattern:** `nav` labelled "Ruta de navegación" with an ordered list; the last item is `aria-current="page"` and is not a link.
- Separators are decorative and hidden from screen readers.
- Each link is 44 px tall.

## Content

- Use the page's short name, not its full title.
